title: Deterministic spoken guidance
purpose: Convert tracked target observations into simple, deterministic movement instructions and speak them without unnecessary repetition.
architecturalScope: Guidance bounded context. GuidanceGenerator + SpeechOutputPort. Consumes TargetTrack/ProductCandidate; contains no model calls.
domainContext: NavigationInstruction, RelativePosition, Confidence, Distance (qualitative: near/far/directly ahead).

milestones.title: Instruction rules
milestones.description: Deterministic mapping from relative position to instruction.

milestones.title: Non-repeating speech output
milestones.description: Identical instructions are suppressed; state changes are prioritised and obsolete speech interrupted.

tasks.title: Define instruction rules for horizontal/vertical/size
acceptanceCriteria: Rules are pure functions, unit-testable without audio.

tasks.title: Implement speech output with deduplication and interruption
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated identical instructions are not re-spoken.
New state changes interrupt obsolete instructions.
evidence: app/tests/dragon-voice-live.test.ts green (55 KB RIFF/WAV from local runtime)

acceptanceCriteria: Instructions are deterministic for identical observations.
Only qualitative distance terms are used unless depth supports more.
Every instruction is understandable without any visual cue.

risks.description: Instructions conflict with the screen reader.
Exact distances are inferred from box size and stated as fact.
risks.mitigation: Qualitative terms only; no metric claim without depth.

safetyImplications: Never say 'you can go' or imply a guaranteed clear path.
accessibilityImplications: This is the primary user-facing output channel and must be fully non-visual.
verificationRequirements: Unit tests for the instruction rule table.

decisionLog.decision: Speech output supports a local Dragon-Voice/Piper adapter behind the SpeechOutput port; browser speechSynthesis remains the zero-install default.
decisionLog.rationale: Local TTS avoids cloud dependency; the token is local-only and must never be committed.
